title: Construction of higher order symplectic integrators
Symplectic integrators and their application to dynamical astronomy
Training expected for future public plant breeders
An AI-Driven Simulation Framework Integrating Fourth-Order Symplectic Integration and Online Bayesian Calibration
venue: 2025 IEEE 7th International Conference on Civil Aviation Safety and Information Technology (ICCASIT)
abstract: A simulation framework is presented that combines a fourth-order symplectic integrator—ensuring long-term energy conservation and structural fidelity in Hamiltonian dynamics—with an online Bayesian calibration mechanism based on the Kennedy–O’Hagan model for real-time adaptive parameter tuning using sensor feedback. The modular, language-agnostic design supports implementation in performant system languages (e.g., Zig) for efficient concurrency and memory control. This coupling yields a digital twin capable of accurately mirroring physical systems under dynamic operational contexts, facilitating AI-guided decision-making in control and robotics applications. Comparative evaluations demonstrate superior stability over traditional integrators and reduced calibration error in changing environments. The framework advances the state-of-the-art in Artificial Intelligence for adaptive, high-fidelity simulation.
